title: Low-risk asbestos exception still reaches the new permit clause
summary: The unchanged low-risk exception reaches the whole section containing the newly introduced permit.
euChange: Demolition/removal permits; low-risk derogation concerns notification only.
nationalGap: Section 5(3) permits omission of the whole of Section 6 for qualifying low-risk work. New Section 6(4)–(6) contains the permit and public-list provisions, potentially excluding qualifying low-risk asbestos removal.
nationalLaw: Regulation 224/2007, current from 25 January 2026, Sections 5–6; amended by Regulation 6/2026.
consequence: Possibly. The express exception could bypass permit scrutiny for otherwise covered low-risk removal. No company, operation or harm has been established.
resolution: Current official metadata retains this version. No later narrowing of Section 5(3) was located.
caveat: This concerns removal/demolition within EU scope, not every low-risk activity. General prevention, exposure limits, training and health surveillance remain. Section 6(4) and consistent interpretation may constrain the exception; actual administrative practice requires legal assessment.
review: Two agents and the lead independently checked the clauses, EU derogation and current parent statute. Qualified concern.

comparison.before: Low-risk exception reaches the whole permit section.
